correctness.rationale: Every gap move conserves each residue modulo I and tagged position modulo gcd(L,I). A positive quantum moves around the directed gap cycle to connect all weak compositions and shift the mark by I. Positive product-form weights satisfy site-index-shifted global balance separately for both hopping directions. Coefficient extraction yields the exact sector current. An independently assembled generator checked 186 parameter cases, 28,413 states and 3,444 exact rational class balances; enumeration is corroboration, not the proof. Unproved: mixing times and untagged quotient-class counts.

value.rationale: Exact ergodic fragmentation has direct consequences for transport: at one fixed density and set of hopping rates, frozen configurations with zero current coexist with active irreducible phases of strictly signed current. The criterion I ≤ L−N ≤ N(I−1) and classwise partition-function current characterize precisely when the source's Gibbs-ensemble flux cannot summarize every initial state.
